_doc: Field-scoped AVAILABILITY evidence, one entry per attributable source per player. Extends the result-evidence discipline. claim is one of confirmed_unavailable | limited_gtd -- nothing else may be asserted. Only an ATTRIBUTABLE PUBLIC source (school_release, school_site, beat_report, broadcast) can support a claim; kind community_forum and cody_observation are SIGNALS -- stored, labelled, and never able to set a status. Every entry carries the exact quoted wording, url, retrieved time, an effective date range and a review_by date; evidence past review_by or outside its effective range supports nothing and the player falls back to the honest default. Support never spills: one entry, one player, one claim, one date range. A DNP row, a zero-action listing, reduced minutes, a roster omission or a social post is NEVER promoted into out/injured/unavailable, and no diagnosis is ever shown unless an official public source used that exact language -- and then only as the source's own quoted words.
